text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ouch! Ouch-ouch! I'm taking hits here!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Someone has boarded my head! It must be a 
Japanese ninja!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Pricking, and sometimes throbbing, pain! 
Rhythmical Kunai are coming for you, ya 
hear!
choice_data_list: You mean you have a headache?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, anything is fine! Begone, great 
Buddha, goodbye paiin!!

"And so, Taiki Shuttle was troubled by a 
headache..."
